title: jasminum kerrii
intro: Jasminum kerrii, commonly known as the Maidenhair Jasmine, is a flowering plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum kerrii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties. However, the specific bioactive constituents of Jasminum kerrii have not been extensively documented, but its potential health benefits are thought to be due to its ability to interact with the body's nervous system and promote a sense of calm.
